snippet.title: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition | 2026 Launch Trailer - English Language Version
snippet.description:
You Are Empty: Absolute Edition releases on October 27th 2026 (You Are Empty's 20th Anniversary) on Steam, Epic Games Store, and ZOOM Platform!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4760480/You_Are_Empty_Absolute_Edition/

https://www.zoom-platform.com/product/you-are-empty-absolute-edition

In an alternate history 1950s Soviet Kyiv, most of the city's population has mysteriously vanished, and uncontrollable, horrific monsters roam its abandoned streets. Fate has brought you face to face with the ominous emptiness of a dead city that watches its only visitor with unwavering attention. Face bizarre enemies born from propaganda, science, and madness as you uncover the truth behind the catastrophe, and try to make things right.

Features:

• Explore surreal locations across an alternate history Soviet Union, including collective farms, the Metro, an opera house, city rooftops, secret laboratories, and more.

• Use an arsenal of classic weapons, including the C96 Broomhandle pistol, PPSh submachine gun, Mosin rifle, double barrel shotgun, Molotov cocktails, and experimental retrofuturistic weaponry.

• Distinctive, grotesque enemies inspired by Soviet themes.

• Experience one of Eastern Europe's most unusual cult FPS titles, faithfully revitalized for modern systems.
